publicationName: Journal of cell communication and signaling

snippet: Lung adenocarcinoma (LUAD) progression is shaped by aberrant cell-cell and cell-matrix communication within a heterogeneous tumor microenvironment (TME). This study integrates single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq), genome-wide association study, and spatial transcriptomics to identify epithelial subpopulations associated with this crosstalk.
